name: Ripon Park Play Area
description: Fenced play area for children up to 13 with toddler and junior multi-units, swings, rotor dish, see-saw and climbing boulder, plus a zip wire and small BMX-style cycle track outside, beside Three Ways Community Centre.

nearby.label: Free car park by the community centre (limited spaces)
